gloss: society of commerce and industry; local business association

definitions.gloss: society of commerce and industry; local business association
definitions.explanation: A statutory local organization of small businesses in a town or village. It offers management advice, bookkeeping help, and loan support to member shops and workshops, and often runs local events.

examples.japanese: {商工会|しょうこうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I joined the society of commerce and industry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{商工会|しょうこうかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{主催|しゅさい}している→主催する：17278_shusaisuru⟧。
examples.english: The town's society of commerce and industry organizes the summer festival.

examples.japanese: {商工会|しょうこうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}{窓口|まどぐち}→相談窓口：23532_soudanmadoguchi⟧で、⟦{開業|かいぎょう}→開業：14570_kaigyou⟧⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{借|か}り{方|かた}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{助言|じょげん}→助言：05461_jogen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: At the business association's advice desk, I got guidance on how to borrow start-up funds.

notes:
Formed from {商工|しょうこう} (commerce and industry) + ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (association). Each town or village typically has one, and membership is common for small local businesses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {商工会|しょうこうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to join the association
- {商工会|しょうこうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧: a member of the association
- {商工会|しょうこうかい}{青年部|せいねんぶ}: the association's young members' division
- {商工会|しょうこうかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{主催|しゅさい}する→主催する：17278_shusaisuru⟧: to be hosted by the association

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{商工会議所|しょうこうかいぎしょ}→商工会議所：30108_shoukoukaigisho⟧: chamber of commerce and industry — the equivalent body in cities, generally larger
- ⟦{組合|くみあい}→組合：02669_kumiai⟧: union; cooperative — a broader word for any member association
